definition: A file sent together with an email.
exampleSentence: I forgot to add the attachment, so I sent the email again.

definition: A message that helps someone remember something.
exampleSentence: I set a reminder in my calendar for the dentist appointment.

definition: A request for someone to come to an event or meeting.
exampleSentence: Everyone in the team received an invitation to the annual party.

definition: A written record of what was said in a meeting.
exampleSentence: Sarah will write the minutes and share them after the meeting.

definition: A short written message sent inside a company.
exampleSentence: The manager sent a memo about the new parking rules.

definition: An official statement that gives information to people.
exampleSentence: The CEO made an important announcement at the staff meeting.

definition: A question asking for information.
exampleSentence: We received an inquiry from a customer about our prices.

definition: A statement that something is wrong or not good enough.
exampleSentence: The hotel manager answered the complaint within one hour.

definition: A document that tells a customer how much a job will cost.
exampleSentence: Please send us a quotation for fifty new laptops.

definition: An official document a company sends to buy something.
exampleSentence: Finance must approve the purchase order before we buy the servers.

definition: A paper or email that shows you paid for something.
exampleSentence: Keep the receipt so the company can pay you back.

definition: Money spent on something, often for work.
exampleSentence: Taxi fares are a common travel expense for our sales team.

definition: Money paid back to you for costs you had for work.
exampleSentence: Submit your receipts to finance to get a reimbursement.

definition: The system for paying employees and the list of their salaries.
exampleSentence: The payroll team makes sure everyone is paid on time.

definition: A meeting where a manager reviews an employee's work.
exampleSentence: My yearly appraisal with my manager is scheduled for next Tuesday.

definition: The act of officially leaving your job.
exampleSentence: She handed in her resignation after five years at the company.

definition: A short period of work to gain experience, often for students.
exampleSentence: He did a summer internship at a software company in Istanbul.

definition: A person who works for different companies without a permanent contract.
exampleSentence: We hired a freelancer to design our new logo.

definition: A person who owns part of a company.
exampleSentence: Every shareholder received a report about the company's profits.

definition: A company that sells similar products to the same customers.
exampleSentence: Our main competitor lowered its prices last month.

definition: A statement about what will probably happen in the future.
exampleSentence: The sales forecast for next year looks very positive.

definition: When two companies join to become one.
exampleSentence: After the merger, the two companies moved into one building.

definition: To say that you have received something or that something is true.
exampleSentence: Please acknowledge this email so I know you received it.

definition: To move an event to a later time.
exampleSentence: We have to postpone the meeting because the manager is sick.

definition: To change the time of a planned event.
exampleSentence: Can we reschedule our call for Thursday afternoon?

definition: To send an email you received to someone else.
exampleSentence: Please forward this email to the finance team.

definition: To make something easier to understand.
exampleSentence: Could you clarify what you mean by a small change?

definition: To suggest that something is good or suitable.
exampleSentence: I recommend this course to anyone who wants to learn Python.

definition: To give someone information officially.
exampleSentence: We will inform all customers about the price change by email.

definition: To pay someone back for money they spent.
exampleSentence: The company will reimburse your travel costs within two weeks.

definition: To say yes to an offer or invitation.
exampleSentence: I am happy to accept your offer to join the team.

definition: To politely say no to an offer or invitation.
exampleSentence: She decided to decline the job offer because the salary was too low.

definition: Speaking or behaving in a respectful way.
exampleSentence: Always be polite when you answer a customer's complaint.

definition: Giving information clearly in few words.
exampleSentence: Keep your emails concise because managers are very busy.

definition: Not done or paid by the expected time.
exampleSentence: The client has three overdue invoices from last summer.

definition: Waiting to be decided or completed.
exampleSentence: Your holiday request is still pending approval from your manager.

definition: To answer an email so that everyone who received it gets your reply.
exampleSentence: Do not reply all unless everyone really needs your answer.

definition: A formal way to begin a letter or email when you do not know the name.
exampleSentence: Start the letter with Dear Sir or Madam if you do not know the name.

definition: A polite way to end a formal email.
exampleSentence: Most business emails end with Kind regards and your name.

term: I hope this email finds you well
definition: A polite phrase used to start a formal email.
exampleSentence: Many formal emails begin with the line I hope this email finds you well.
